```{r save-estimates}
nlmixr2save::saveFit(fit, paste0(FIT_FAM, "_estimates"))

write.csv(as.data.frame(fit$eta), file = paste0(FIT_FAM, "_ebe.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved", paste0(FIT_FAM, "_estimates.zip"), "| OBJF:", sprintf("%.3f", fit$objf),
    "| fitted names:", paste(names(fixef(fit)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r fit-head-boot, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(sprintf("\n# %s. Optional: Bootstrap Confidence Intervals\n\n", FIT_SEC[["boot"]]))
```

```{r bootstrap, eval=RUN_BOOTSTRAP, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
dir.create(paste0(FIT_FAM, "_bootstrap_cache"), showWarnings = FALSE)
boot_args <- list(fit = fit, nboot = BOOT_NBOOT, stdErrType = BOOT_STDERR,
                  ci = BOOT_CI, returnType = "model", restart = BOOT_RESTART,
                  fitName = FIT_FAM)
if (!is.null(BOOT_STRAT)) boot_args$stratVar <- BOOT_STRAT
fit_boot <- rxode2::.rxWithWd(paste0(FIT_FAM, "_bootstrap_cache"),
                              do.call(nlmixr2extra::bootstrapFit, boot_args))
assign("bootCI", BOOT_CI, envir = fit_boot$env)
nlmixr2save::saveFit(fit_boot, paste0(FIT_FAM, "_bootstrap"))

bs <- lapply(fit_boot$bootSummary$parFixedDf, as.data.frame)
cat("Bootstrap done -", nrow(bs$mean), "parameters,",
    sprintf("%.0f %% percentile CI:", 100 * BOOT_CI), "\n")
print(data.frame(Parameter = rownames(bs$confLower),
                 Estimate  = bs$mean$Estimate,
                 Lower     = bs$confLower$Estimate,
                 Upper     = bs$confUpper$Estimate,
                 row.names = NULL))
```

```{r fit-head-scm, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(sprintf("\n# %s. Optional: Covariate Search (SCM)\n\n", FIT_SEC[["scm"]]))
```

```{r scm, eval=RUN_SCM}
cat("covarSearchAuto() cannot be used on a model with alag()/f(); see HANDOVER.md 13.14 - the search is run by word-report/run_pipeline.R\n")
if (FALSE) {  # covarSearchAuto() lane disabled on purpose: see HANDOVER.md 13.14 - kept for reference
mu_ok <- tryCatch(nrow(fit$finalUiEnv$muRefDataFrame) > 0, error = function(e) FALSE)
if (!mu_ok)
  stop("SCM: the fitted model is not mu-referenced the way nlmixr2extra needs ",
       "(muRefDataFrame is empty), so covarSearchAuto() cannot add a covariate ",
       "to it.  See the comment above this chunk.", call. = FALSE)

dir.create(paste0(FIT_FAM, "_scm_cache"), showWarnings = FALSE)
scm_forward <- list()
fit_scm <- fit
for (p in names(SCM_MAP)) {
  covs <- SCM_MAP[[p]]
  if (!length(covs)) next
  r <- rxode2::.rxWithWd(paste0(FIT_FAM, "_scm_cache"), nlmixr2extra::covarSearchAuto(
    fit_scm, varsVec = p, covarsVec = covs,
    catvarsVec = intersect(covs, SCM_CAT),
    pVal = SCM_PVAL, searchType = "forward", restart = SCM_RESTART))
  scm_forward[[length(scm_forward) + 1L]] <- r$resFwd[[2]]
  fit_scm <- r$resFwd[[1]]
}
scm_record <- do.call(rbind, scm_forward)
rownames(scm_record) <- NULL

if (SCM_SEARCH %in% c("scm", "backward") && any(scm_record$included == "yes")) {
  r <- rxode2::.rxWithWd(paste0(FIT_FAM, "_scm_cache"), nlmixr2extra::covarSearchAuto(
    fit_scm, varsVec = names(SCM_MAP), covarsVec = unique(unlist(SCM_MAP)),
    catvarsVec = intersect(unique(unlist(SCM_MAP)), SCM_CAT),
    pVal = SCM_PVAL, searchType = "backward", restart = SCM_RESTART))
  scm_record <- rbind(scm_record, r$resBck[[2]])
  fit_scm <- r$resBck[[1]]
}

write.csv(scm_record, paste0(FIT_FAM, "_scm_record.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

scm_kept <- scm_record[scm_record$included == "yes", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(scm_kept)) {
  nlmixr2save::saveFit(fit_scm, paste0(FIT_FAM, "_scm_final"))
  cat("SCM kept:", paste(unique(scm_kept$covNames), collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("SCM kept no covariate effect; stage 3 will report the base model.\n")
}
}  # end disabled covarSearchAuto() lane (HANDOVER.md 13.14)
```
